verdict.rationale: Outlook's own Graph mail API lets a user or agent delete messages, attachments, and notes. sendMail also has a flag controlling whether a copy is kept in Sent Items, giving some per-item deletion and retention control. However, nothing in the pack covers retention policies, automatic expiry, or purge guarantees. Missing for 10: configurable retention policies or auto-delete schedules, permanent purge and recoverable-items behavior, account-level data deletion and export controls, and independent corroboration.
